case.physics: unchanged original Ogden exponent2, K=149mu/3, hex8 three-field, laugon0, bonded plates/free side; accepted axial half-height reconstruction
case.reference_choice: original uniform N24 P1 and original uniform full N16; do not mix P4 into the global sequence
case.reference_geometry: same measured specimen dimensions and original five-block uniform extrusion rule

forecast_not_observation.basis: frozen existing N12/16/24 endpoint power law; N32 has not been generated or solved
forecast_not_observation.expected_implication: approximately2.7percent remaining bias could still exceed2percent allowance; this prospective check is not expected or promised to unlock calibration

generalized_order.apply_at: each of the 61 common signed-force states; state0 reported as rest/not_estimated; endpoint at minus15percent strain separately primary
generalized_order.eligibility: all finite; both abs increments strictly greater than1.6e-7N; same nonzero sign; R>a/b; unique p in[1e-6,16]; no clipping, sign repair or prescribed nominal order
generalized_order.inputs: n1<n2<n3; d12=F(n2)-F(n1); d23=F(n3)-F(n2); preserve signed forces
generalized_order.low_difference_states: if both abs increments<=1.6e-7N label below_original_difference_floor and do not estimate order; this is not a remainder bound; if only one is below, label insufficient_increment_resolution
generalized_order.model: F(N)=F_infinity+C*(1/N)^p; conditional discretization model, not an observed continuum limit
generalized_order.order_uncertainty: report p history and both consecutive absolute p changes; do not infer asymptotic behavior from positive p alone
generalized_order.other_triplets: apply the identical algorithm to N8/12/16 and N12/16/24, including cases with increasing raw adjacent differences; retain their original frozen study status
generalized_order.root_algorithm: bisect p on[0,16] for80iterations; at0 evaluate a/b; stable expm1 expression otherwise; refuse if R<=a/b or R>q(16); return null if final p<1e-6 or any intermediate/limit is nonfinite
generalized_order.signed_remaining_indicator: e32=d23/expm1(p*ln(32/24)); F_infinity_est=F32+e32; report abs(e32) and signed e32

instability_and_screen.T_force: 1.6e-7N+0.02*max_over61states(abs(F_N32)); identical original series-wide force-change allowance used as a conservative remaining-error screen without weakening it
instability_and_screen.all_state_reporting: report every state, eligibility counts, maximum eligible E and the state attaining it; do not hide unestimated states under a maximum over eligible states
instability_and_screen.candidate_screen: all original individual and N24/N32 change checks pass; endpoint order eligible; no instability flags at resolved states; all resolved-state E<=T_force; unresolved non-rest states prevent a full-curve spatial-accuracy claim
instability_and_screen.drift_flag: where all three triplet orders are eligible, flag increasing_order_drift when abs(p16_24_32-p12_16_24)>abs(p12_16_24-p8_12_16)+1e-6; this is a prospective diagnostic judgment, not an original gate or universal theorem
instability_and_screen.eligibility_failure: opposite signs, missing/invalid states, no admissible positive root, unresolved increments or nonfinite extrapolation => no order-based accuracy screen at that state
instability_and_screen.limit_disagreement_flag: flag force_limit_instability when abs(F_infinity_est16_24_32-F_infinity_est12_16_24)>T_force; report earlier8/12/16 limit separately as coarse-grid history
instability_and_screen.two_latest_limit_envelope: at each eligible state E=max(abs(F_infinity_est16_24_32-F32),abs(F_infinity_est12_16_24-F32)); model-sensitivity envelope only, not a rigorous bound
instability_and_screen.when_remaining_bias_exceeds_tolerance: No acceptance of numerical force accuracy under the original force allowance is supported, even if adjacent changes pass2percent. Report remaining_spatial_error_not_within_allowance, retain the historical failure and keep calibration closed. The exceedance is conditional extrapolation evidence, not proof of divergence.
instability_and_screen.when_screen_is_satisfied: At most a candidate for finest-level temporal verification and independent review; not continuum certification, physical validation or automatic calibration release.

stopping_rules: Require independent numerical-design review before implementation; then freeze source and issue separate preparation/solve releases before their respective execution.
Stop terminally on first resource, preparation, native or individual-readout failure; preserve partial evidence.
Finish and report this single N32 observation even if the spatial screen fails; no automatic N40/N48 sweep or further plate split.
Do not launch S120 until the spatial model is selected by explicit review; temporal-only agreement cannot cure unresolved spatial error.
Before calibration, selected axial levels still requireS120 using original0.2percent reaction and0.8micrometer motion tolerances; torsion holdouts remain closed and unchanged.

unchanged_observation_checks.N16_full_N24_half: use accepted reconstruction identities; no new N16 symmetry study
unchanged_observation_checks.original_raw_trend: retain and report original strict decrease/floor comparison as its own historical-style metric; never substitute it for generalized-order/remainder analysis

study.release_required: Separate explicit source-archive/interpreter/runtime/mesher-bound preparation and solve releases; declaration grants neither.
